name: Orenna Tash
lore: Orenna remembers every convoy that vanished beyond the beacons. She turns those losses into strict marching law, keeping scattered operatives moving as one battered fleet.

abilities.name: Convoy Law
abilities.text: Once per round, when you reveal or accept a Contract, reduce scenario pressure by 1 if it is above 0.

abilities.name: Old Oaths
abilities.text: Once per round, when you accept a Contract, gain +1 on your next Command check this turn.

abilities.name: Fleet Memory
abilities.text: At the start of your turn, reduce scenario pressure by 1 if it is above 0.
